# Intermittent DNS resolution failures for internal services

Applications intermittently fail to reach internal hostnames; retries usually succeed a few seconds later.

One of three internal resolvers had a stale root hints file and was silently failing recursive queries; round-robin sent ~1/3 of queries to the bad resolver.

1. Query each resolver directly to isolate which returns SERVFAIL
2. Refresh root hints and flush the cache on the failing resolver
3. Restart the named service and re-run validation queries
4. Add a health check to the resolver load-balancer pool

Error Details
```
dig: ;; connection timed out; no servers could be reached; SERVFAIL for api.internal.corp; resolver returned NXDOMAIN intermittently
```

Tags: dns, servfail, resolver, bind9, intermittent
